# Pigment LLM Guide

@oxog/pigment - Zero-dependency terminal styling with micro-kernel architecture and Chalk drop-in compatibility.

## Quick Start

```typescript
// Primary: Proxy-based chaining
import { pigment } from '@oxog/pigment';
pigment.bold.red('Error!');
pigment.italic.blue.bgWhite('Info');

// Alternative: Function composition (tree-shakeable)
import { bold, red, compose } from '@oxog/pigment';
const error = compose(bold, red);

// Alternative: Builder pattern
import { createPigment } from '@oxog/pigment';
const p = createPigment().bold().red();
p.paint('Styled text');

// Chalk-compatible (drop-in replacement)
import chalk from '@oxog/pigment';
chalk.red.bold('Error');
```

## Colors

```typescript
// 16 base colors
pigment.black|red|green|yellow|blue|magenta|cyan|white

// Bright variants
pigment.blackBright|redBright|greenBright|yellowBright|blueBright|magentaBright|cyanBright|whiteBright

// Aliases
pigment.gray|grey

// Background colors
pigment.bgBlack|bgRed|bgGreen|bgYellow|bgBlue|bgMagenta|bgCyan|bgWhite
```

## Modifiers

```typescript
pigment.bold|dim|italic|underline|strikethrough|inverse|hidden|reset('text')
```

## Extended Colors

```typescript
// ANSI 256 (0-255)
pigment.ansi256(196)('Bright red');
pigment.bgAnsi256(21)('Blue background');

// True color (RGB)
pigment.rgb(255, 136, 0)('Orange');
pigment.bgRgb(0, 120, 255)('Blue background');

// HEX
pigment.hex('#FF8800')('Orange');
pigment.bgHex('#0078FF')('Blue background');

// HSL
pigment.hsl(30, 100, 50)('Orange');
pigment.bgHsl(210, 100, 50)('Blue background');
```

## Environment

```typescript
import { supportsColor, detectColorSupport } from '@oxog/pigment';

// Check color support
supportsColor; // { level: 3, hasBasic: true, has256: true, has16m: true }

// Override level
const pigment = createPigment({ level: 3 });

// Environment variables
// NO_COLOR - disables all colors
// FORCE_COLOR=3 - forces true color
```

## Plugins

```typescript
import { createPigment } from '@oxog/pigment';
import { gradientPlugin, themePlugin, semanticPlugin } from '@oxog/pigment/plugins';

const pigment = createPigment({
  plugins: [gradientPlugin(), themePlugin({ preset: 'monokai' }), semanticPlugin()]
});

// Gradient
pigment.gradient('red', 'blue')('Text');

// Theme
pigment.theme.keyword('const');
pigment.theme.string('"text"');
pigment.theme.error('Error!');

// Semantic
pigment.success('✓ Done');
pigment.error('✗ Failed');
pigment.warning('⚠ Warning');
pigment.info('ℹ Info');
```

## Chalk Compatibility

```typescript
// All Chalk v5 features work
chalk.red('text');
chalk.bold('text');
chalk.red.bold('text');
chalk.rgb(255, 0, 0)('text');
chalk.hex('#FF0000')('text');
chalk.ansi256(196)('text');
chalk.bgRed('text');
chalk.visible('text');
chalk.level; // 0-3
chalk.supportsColor; // ColorSupport object
new Chalk({ level: 2 });
```

## Nested Styles

```typescript
pigment.red(`Error: ${pigment.bold('critical')} issue`);
```

## Platform Support

- Node.js: ANSI escape codes
- Browser: CSS %c styling
- Auto-detects platform
- Same API everywhere

## Key Features

- Zero dependencies (not even @oxog packages)
- Micro-kernel architecture with plugin system
- Chalk v5 drop-in compatible
- Universal (Node.js + Browser)
- TypeScript strict mode
- 100% test coverage target
- < 3KB core gzipped, < 12KB full gzipped

## Plugin Options

```typescript
// Gradient
gradientPlugin({ steps: 10 })

// Theme (presets: monokai, dracula, nord, github, vscode, tokyo-night, catppuccin, one-dark, solarized)
themePlugin({ preset: 'monokai', custom: { error: '#FF0000' } })

// Semantic (customizable colors)
semanticPlugin({ success: '#00FF00', error: '#FF0000' })

// Box (border: single, double, rounded, bold, classic)
boxPlugin({ border: 'double', padding: 2 })
```

## Ecosystem Integration

```typescript
import { pigmentPlugin } from '@oxog/pigment/plugins';

// For @oxog/log, @oxog/cli
log.use(pigmentPlugin({ theme: 'monokai', level: 3 }));
```

## Important Notes

- NO_COLOR environment variable disables all colors
- FORCE_COLOR=0-3 forces color level
- TTY detection for non-color terminals
- All color codes validated (0-255 for ANSI 256, 0-255 for RGB)
- All imports are tree-shakeable
